notes.3: This question concerned average speed, and was generally well answered. Those candidates who wrongly chose option B may not have taken account of ‘in the air’ in the question, despite this phrase being printed in bold. �PAGE�6
notes.6: Although the vast majority of responses to this question on density were correct, some of the lower-achieving candidates did not subtract the mass of the empty measuring cylinder, therefore opting for D.
notes.9: This was generally a well answered question; however some of the lower-achieving candidates chose option C, possibly having not taken account of the emboldened ‘within the battery’. Candidates should always pay particular attention to any text written in bold.
notes.12: This question was not answered correctly by a sizeable proportion of candidates, with many thinking that a narrower tube would cause h to increase.
notes.14: Responses to this question on evaporation showed some confusion over cause and effect, with some candidates opting for B, possibly due to a misconception that energy would be conducted away from the water through the metal dish, rather than into the water, as would happen once the water started to cool.
notes.17: A significant number of candidates thought that thermal conduction only occurred in solids, neglecting substances such as mercury, or indeed any other molten metals.
notes.23: This question concerned the image produced by a converging lens and was less well answered than many others. Many candidates opted for B, an object position that would produce an enlarged image.
notes.25: Many of the lower-achieving candidates were unable to average the set of results in this question, and opted for distractor B.
notes.29: The most common mistake was to calculate the p.d. across the 30Ω resistor and giving this as the answer, rather than subtracting it from 6.0V.
notes.32: The potential divider caused problems, with all options proving popular.
notes.33: A significant number of candidates thought that the low-rated fuse would not only blow, but also cause damage to the kettle.
